title: Kathua rape and murder case
narrative: FIR — Kathua rape and murder case, Rasana village near Kathua, Jammu and Kashmir. In January 2018, Asifa Bano, an eight-year-old girl of the nomadic Bakarwal community, was abducted while grazing horses, held captive for several days inside a temple, sedated, gang-raped, and then murdered by strangulation and a blow to the head with a stone. Her father Mohammad Yusuf reported her missing on 12 January 2018 and her body was recovered a week later. The crime branch named Sanji Ram, a temple custodian, as the mastermind, along with special police officer Deepak Khajuria and others. The trial concluded on 10 June 2019 with six of the seven accused convicted.
